lines.en: I keep low, and my steps come fast.
The horns on my head come first.
My skull is short and heavy.

lines.zh: 我沿着地面嗅，一路小跑。
lines.en: I run along, sniffing the ground.
I lower my body and move at a quick pace.

lines.zh: 我几步就穿过这片空地。
lines.en: A few strides carry me across the clearing.
I kick up dirt when I turn.
My hind legs are stronger than my front ones.
I head for that noise.
I walk and scan around me.
A low rumble sits in my throat.
One step flattens a patch of grass.
I close in on that bush.
I stop and turn an ear forward.
I paw at the dirt where I stand.
Steam puffs from my nostrils.
I scrape one foot against the ground.
I'm listening to footsteps far off.
My horns have grown hot in the sun.

lines.zh: 我在地上闻到了一股味道。
lines.en: I caught a scent on the ground.
I open my mouth and pant.
I stare at that patch of shade.
My horns glint in the sun.
I'm deciding which way to go.
My tail sweeps the dry grass.
I give a low roar.
I'm a little impatient.
These horns of mine hurt on impact.
You're standing three blocks in front of me.

lines.zh: 我咆哮之后，就会撞过来。
lines.en: I roar, then I charge.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈和火把的味。
lines.en: You smell of rust and torch flame.

lines.zh: 我的影子先罩住你半边。
lines.en: My shadow blankets half of you first.
Keep staring and I'll charge.
Don't run — if you run, I chase.
My horns point straight at you.

lines.zh: 你抬手的瞬间，我看见了。
lines.en: The instant you raised your hand, I saw it.

lines.zh: 你的气味我记在鼻子里了。
lines.en: I've kept your scent.
Inside three blocks, I charge.
I open my mouth, and it isn't a yawn.
Back up a little. Then I charge.
I shake the dirt off my horns.
I growl and give half a step.
My flank has gone numb.
These horns are for charging.
I shake the dirt off.

lines.zh: 我转过身，看着伤我的东西。
lines.en: I turn to face whatever hurt me.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，血滴在脚背上。
lines.en: I shake my head, and blood drips onto my feet.
I don't intend to retreat.
I lick the wound at my mouth.
I'm still standing — again.
That meat is still dripping.
I lower my horns toward that meat.

lines.zh: 我这对小角，专用来顶撞。
lines.en: These little horns are for ramming.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一步步靠近。
lines.en: I crouch low and close in step by step.
Set it down and step away.
I sniff first, then bite.
That won't buy you anything.
The meat in your hand is still dripping.
My tongue runs over my teeth.
I swallow once.
My breastbone is hard as stone.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的角，疼的是你。
lines.en: You hit my horns—you're the one hurting.
I shoulder you aside.
My hide is hard.

lines.zh: 这一下没让你摔倒算客气。
lines.en: You didn't fall, and that's courtesy.

lines.zh: 我转了半个身，角对着你。
lines.en: I turned half around, horns toward you.

lines.zh: 我这对角一低头，就是要冲。
lines.en: Head lowered, my horns mean a charge.
You'd better clear the way.
I growl low and push forward.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞得你退了两步。
lines.en: My shoulder knocked you back two steps.
Another is at the edge of the wood.

lines.zh: 我朝她走过去，步子放慢。
lines.en: I walk to her, slowing my pace.
Our horns nearly touch.
I dip my head, and so does she.

lines.zh: 我的角轻轻碰了碰它的。
lines.en: My horns tap lightly against theirs.
I touch her neck with my snout.
This land can feed us.
First we find a nest site.
Afterward we go our own ways.
I stop calling and just walk beside her.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它，甩了两下。
lines.en: I bite it and shake it twice.
A strip of meat tears free.
I swallow it bones and all.
I turn with it in my jaws.
One gulp and it's gone. Not enough.
I crush the bone.
I pin it down and take the first bite.
My jaws are covered in blood.
I've pinned it underfoot.
It took some effort.

lines.zh: 风把猎物的味道送来了。
lines.en: The wind brings me the smell of prey.
I snap my head that way.
It turned—I've marked it.
My body drops first.
These two legs were built to charge.
I charge at it.
Grass breaks under my feet.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我的角就对着它。
lines.en: It turned, and my horns are lined up.
This hit goes into its flank.
My hind legs are braced.
It's backed against the rocks.
I won't give it time.

lines.zh: 我的角朝前，牙齿露出来。
lines.en: My horns point forward; my teeth show.
This stretch is long enough to build speed.
I walk tight circles around it.
My horns dip low.
It runs left, and I cut across.
I kick the dust up high.
I charge low along the ground.

lines.zh: 牛龙的双角压低，准备冲撞。
lines.en: The carnotaurus's horns drop — it's winding up to charge.
I still have strength to spare.
Its flank is open.
Two blocks closer.
I roar, and it freezes.
This charge has to land solid.
It's backing up.
I turn in tight against it.
I raise my head toward its neck.
I charge right now.
One roar and I cannot stop.
It rolls away from the impact.
I bite into its shoulder.
I shake my head and flip it over.
I knock it over and gore with my horns.

lines.zh: 它撞击在我头上，我晃了晃。
lines.en: It strikes my head and I sway.
I pin its leg underfoot.
Blood splashes my horns.
That bite didn't hold.
I back off a few metres and charge.

lines.zh: 我的短颌锁死了，拔不出来。
lines.en: My short jaws lock, and they won't come loose.
It's still moving; it can still hold on.
I shove it against the tree.
My teeth jarred.

lines.zh: 我从林边的尘土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dust at the wood's edge.
The horns on my head are small and bright.

lines.zh: 这片地没有别的掠食者。
lines.en: There are no other hunters on this ground.
First I scent a circle around me.
I've pressed a hollow into the ground.
I lower my head, then raise it.
The sun is on my back.
I walk into the wood.
I lift my head and sniff the air.
There's a herd far off.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，哈出一口白气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and breathe out white vapour.

lines.zh: 我把角在地上蹭了两下。
lines.en: I scrape my horns twice on the ground.
This stretch is mine now.
I drop low and run forward.
I hear a heartbeat.
I begin patrolling this land.

lines.zh: 我落地时，泥土陷了下去。
lines.en: When I land, the soil sinks beneath me.
These horns of mine tilt upward.
The flames drive me back.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land dazed.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命挣扎。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils and I thrash.
I roll halfway over and push back up.

lines.zh: 箭钉进腿里，我趔趄了一下。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my leg and I stumble.
That light makes my legs give way.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连跑都没力气。
lines.en: Too long without food, and I can't even run.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I lock up.
The ground is gone and I fall.
